consent_and_disclosure.required_message: The localized disclosure states that local chat is optional, uses the local CPU, makes no fixed response-time SLA, and downloads only after explicit confirmation.

storage_and_integrity.interruption: The fixed staging .part file resumes only with the fixed source and is never runnable or ready until complete verification and atomic promotion.
storage_and_integrity.offline_local_install: A user explicitly supplies one direct regular non-symlink local candidate. BPM copies it only to the fixed staging destination and verifies the same manifest before promotion; the source never selects a destination or a model identity.
storage_and_integrity.corruption: Wrong-size, wrong-checksum, unsafe path, metadata mismatch, insufficient disk, HTTP failure, or unsupported architecture fails closed. No worker is started.
storage_and_integrity.removal: Removal requires explicit confirmation and deletes only the three fixed manifest-owned paths; symlinks are refused.

network_and_runtime_boundary.download: Only the pinned HTTPS artifact source is requested after explicit install confirmation. Redirects are limited to the HTTP client's official artifact flow; proxy environment inheritance is disabled.

development_handoff.make_dev_dependency: make dev depends on ai-model-install-dev and the separate ai-runtime-install-dev after documentation installation
development_handoff.consent_boundary: Invoking the named development command or make dev is explicit maintainer consent for the pinned development bootstrap. It does not change the product's no-implicit-download boundary.
development_handoff.persistence: A verified artifact remains installed under data/ai across subsequent make dev invocations and normal clean-local-artifacts runs. It is never removed, downgraded, or replaced without a separate explicit maintainer instruction and confirmed removal command.
development_handoff.progress: The bootstrap delegates to the install command's flushed real download progress.

operator_commands.progress: The install command emits 0%, every 5% or more, and 100% download progress to stdout.
